title: The European Commission introduces the Digital Fairness Act, which aims to curb addictive design features and manipulative "dark patterns" or face large fines (Gian Volpicelli/Bloomberg)
summary: Gian Volpicelli / Bloomberg: The European Commission introduces the Digital Fairness Act, which aims to curb addictive design features and manipulative “dark patterns” or face large fines — The European Union is debuting a new plan designed to curb practices that manipulate people into spending more time and money online.
